prompt: Make project deletion in the tracker package a soft delete. `delete_project(store, project_id)` keeps the project but marks it deleted. Add `restore_project(store, project_id)`, which brings it back unchanged, tags included, and `deleted_projects(store)`, which lists deleted projects, both in projects.py. A deleted project must not appear or count anywhere else a user can see it: every listing, search, statistic, tag view, export, recent-activity view and quota. Everything that acts on a project treats a deleted one as missing and raises NotFound, including deleting it twice. Its name is free for other projects to use. Restoring raises NameTaken if the name has been reused, and NotFound if the project isn't deleted.
